notes: This contract records the bounded embedded federation-wide SaveInProgress and RestoreInProgress gate exercised by the interlock Catch2 scenario. It covers representative object-class and interaction declaration, object, DDM, update, interaction, ownership, and time services; it does not claim that every RTI service is yet interlocked, nor timed save/restore, durable persistence, distributed transport, protected review, package support, or conformance.
